title: Private Princess Christmas
overview: Princess Violet of Wingravia must complete a tough leadership boot camp in Colorado or risk losing her throne to her uncle.

title: Navigating Christmas
overview: Recently divorced Melanie brings her son to a remote island for Christmas, where she connects with a lighthouse owner.

title: A Very Merry Bridesmaid
overview: Leah's 30th birthday is on Christmas Eve, the same day as her brother's wedding. Her childhood crush is back in town for the wedding and he is determined to make sure her birthday does not go by the wayside.
